title: Patterns
description: Class 3 Patterns: repeating patterns, growing patterns, number patterns and rules — spot what comes next and describe the rule, with worked examples and free tests.

topics.title: Repeating & Growing Patterns
topics.concept:
A pattern is something that repeats in a rule. Two common kinds:

  • Repeating pattern — the same group repeats, like 🔵🔴🔵🔴…
  • Growing pattern — it gets bigger by the same amount each time, like 2, 4, 6, 8…

To continue a pattern, find the rule (what repeats or what is added) and apply it.

topics.title: Number Patterns & Rules
topics.concept:
In a number pattern, look at the gap between numbers to find the rule. The rule can be add, subtract, or multiply.

  • 3, 6, 9, 12 → rule is +3.
  • 40, 35, 30, 25 → rule is −5.
  • 1, 2, 4, 8 → rule is ×2 (doubling).
